title: P-256 sigma rho: method allowance repriced to 4.7x the measured gap, cost side only

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1, M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure, H3 pricing and H-trail (average correction count per trail) premises. Total charged work is at most 2^126.927006 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. The walk is the predecessor's (A=2^24, K=2^32, theta=2^-60, residual Markov factor 400000) with tau=0.4943041 and batches of 2^20 walks. The batched step keeps the predecessor's field rows and tests. Corrections determined by a step's own source point and the table (six subtractions, the finishes of lambda, lambda^2 and t*lambda) are forward branches whose taken fix-ups add their exact extra instructions to a run-wide meter capped after every round at n*CORR+LAMBDA_CAP, CORR=18.959637 per step (the per-site Hoeffding pad is 2^-10, equal to the deviation it covers); the batch-dependent finishes (PRE, iw, inv) stay branch-free. The cap's abort probability uses only the independence of trails' own start coins (each trail's metered count is a function of its coins and the fixed table) and the average premise H-trail: Azuma-Hoeffding over at most K_TRAILS trails gives DELTA_CORR<5.07e-14; the work bound holds regardless. The fixed path is measured at 688,954,753 instructions per 2^20-walk plain round (both input sets; a 128-instruction method allowance added per round (factor 4.7 over the measured 27-per-round QEMU-vs-Callgrind gap)), anchor rounds 5*(2^20-1)+9 more, so C_COMMON=657.116944 and the step charge is 676.082075 against the predecessor's 714.759990. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are included. Peak memory is below 2^77 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^62.848071 units, nonuniform advice zero, and the conditional success margin at least 1e-6 above 0.39. Production probability and universal instruction bounds remain heuristic premises, not certifications. Measurements and finite experiments retain their original scope and attribution.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
